Visitor skips underline elements from output

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

static int32_t c_visitor_visitor_underline_skip_visit_underline(const HTMHtmContext* _ctx, void* _user_data, const char* _text, char** out_custom, size_t* out_len) {
    (void)_ctx;
    (void)_user_data;
    (void)out_custom;
    (void)out_len;
    (void)_text;
    return 2;
}

int main(void) {

    /* Visitor skips underline elements from output */

    HTMHtmVisitorCallbacks _callbacks;
    memset(&_callbacks, 0, sizeof(_callbacks));
    _callbacks.visit_underline = c_visitor_visitor_underline_skip_visit_underline;

    HTMAlefHandle _visitor = htm_visitor_create(&_callbacks);
    assert(_visitor != 0 && "visitor create failed");

    HTMAlefHandle _options = htm_conversion_options_from_json("{}");
    assert(_options != 0 && "options from_json failed");

    htm_options_set_visitor(_options, _visitor);

    HTMAlefHandle _result = htm_convert("<p>Normal text with <u>underlined part</u> and more text.</p>", _options);
    assert(_result != 0 && "visitor call failed");

    htm_conversion_result_free(_result);
    htm_conversion_options_free(_options);
    htm_visitor_free(_visitor);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
